Clock

Set the leds to a ticking clock. The Clock starts on initial_color and move LED by LED (rotation_time_s / 12 for the amount of leds) to the end_color. The LED that is next to swap to end_color will have intermediate_color. This can be used to signify the current time. When the clock ends, the leds will stay on end_color.

Authorizations:
None
Request Body schema: application/json

Clock values

required
object (Clock)

Responses

PuKK REST API

http://{ip_address}/api/setLeds/clock

Request samples

  • Payload
Content type
application/json
{
  • "led_values": {
    • "initial_color": {
      • "brightness": 100,
      • "red": 255,
      • "green": 0,
      • "blue": 0
      },
    • "intermediate_color": {
      • "brightness": 100,
      • "red": 0,
      • "green": 0,
      • "blue": 255
      },
    • "end_color": {
      • "brightness": 100,
      • "red": 0,
      • "green": 255,
      • "blue": 0
      },
    • "rotation_time_s": 60,
    • "counter_clockwise": true
    }
}

Response samples

  • 200
Content type
application/json
{
  • "status": "OK",
  • "message": "Leds successfully set to [100, 255, 255, 255]"
}
